changelog: 🎧 Speech recognition now ships inside the ISO — ThorOS has always run the AI on your own machine, but the part that LISTENS used to download itself the first time you spoke. Fresh installs no longer wait for it, and a machine with no internet can finally hear you.
🔓 Your computer starts ready to listen — hands-free sign-in now applies on the FIRST boot, not the second, so someone who can't use a keyboard is never stuck at a login screen.
🔐 You choose how you sign in — the welcome screen asks whether to start straight to the desktop or require your password. Hands-free is the default; it's your machine.
🐛 Fixed: Jarvis could fail to start on a new install and stay silent until launched by hand — he was reaching for the speech model before the network was awake.
🐛 Fixed: the "Thinking…" status strip has been shipping in a state where it could never launch. It works now.
ℹ️ Known issue: installing with no network cable connected can stall on "Updating the list of available packages". Install connected — you can unplug afterwards and the voice keeps working.
